{{SameName|Brain Rot|[[Brain Rot|2024]] • [[Brain Rot (2026)|2026]]}} {{RemovedSandboxOnly|date = 8th of April 2024}} {{ModifierInfobox |image1 = BrainRotModifier.png |affects = Wave Layout
Enemy Stats (Originally) |active_in = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive
[[Headache Headquarters]] (Originally) |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = +50% |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Skibidi|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer|{{QuoteBox|dop dop yes yes|In-Game Description}}}} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Brain Rot''', internally referred to as '''MemeMode''', is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] originally available in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. It was activated by typing "''dop dop yes yes''" in chat on Wave 0, after the mode vote ended but before Wave 1 started. This would change the current map to [[Headache Headquarters]] and replace most enemies with toilet variants. This, however, did not remove any modifiers from the previous map, such as [[All Paths]]. Currently, it is only available through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Effects== When active, the '''Brain Rot''' modifier replaces the following modern variants of enemies with these variants, some of which were not possible to see in gameplay when it originally released: *The [[Toilet]] replaces the [[Normal]] and [[Abnormal]]. *The [[Streamer]] replaces the [[Speedy]] and [[Quick]]. *The [[Chad]] replaces the [[Slow]] and [[Heavy]]. *The [[Metal Toilet]] replaces the [[Normal Boss]]. *The [[Ninja Toilet]] replaces the [[Hidden]]. *The [[Png Bot2]] replaces the [[Breaker2]]. **The [[Png Bot2]] also spawned [[Png Bot]] upon death. *The [[Brick Man]] replaces the [[Skeleton]]. *The [[Armored Toilet]] replaces the [[Armored]]. *The [[Megatron Toilet]] replaces the [[Slow Boss]]. *The [[Pro Streamer]] replaces the [[Hidden Boss]]. *The [[Arrow]] replaces the [[Bolt]]. *The [[Png Bot4]] replaces the [[Breaker4]]. **The [[Png Bot4]] also spawned [[Png Bot3]] upon death. *The [[Toilet Boss]] replaces the [[Grave Digger]]. Additionally, the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] enemy had its health increased from 500 to 1,200, though this no longer happens. Activating it makes the screen become dark briefly, plays a loud fart sound, makes the message "''The brain rot has begun.''" appear on the screen and then makes the Skibidi track play. ==Trivia== *The '''Brain Rot''' modifier is the first modifier to replace enemies that have hidden immunity with new enemies. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]] **'''Brain Rot''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Brain Rot''' is disabled upon restarting. *'''1 April 2024''' - [[v1.17.2]]a **{{Bugfix}} '''Brain Rot''' is no longer disabled upon restarting. *'''8 April 2024''' - [[v1.18.0]]b **'''Brain Rot''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Brainrot''' re-added, exclusively appearing in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer changes health of the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]. **{{Bug}} Activation message no longer appears. **{{Bug}} No longer changes current track to Skibidi. *'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]] **{{Bug}} Activation message appears a second time when a different modifier is activated or toggled. **{{Bugfix}} Activation message now appears. **{{Bugfix}} Now changes the current music track to Skibidi on activation. *'''1 April 2026''' - [[V1.86.0|v1.86.5a]] **{{Bug}} '''Brain Rot''' is disabled upon reviving. {{ModifierNavBox}}
